book.name: Yohana
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Yohana

content: Yesu bhumpaka mahuta ghaghanungila wichu
Machobha sita mangani ja Uwangalalu wa Pasaka, Yesu akapiti ku Besania, koatamika Lazalo ambaju Yesu akamuhyohiki kuhuma kwa bhakuwa.
Konihoku bhakumbeki chilebhi cha chimihi, najombi Masa akabhi abhatumakila. Lazalo akabhi jumu wa bhala bhabhakabhi bhakula papamu na Yesu.

Bhela Malia akatoliki nusu lita ja mahuta ghaghanungila wichu ghaghalenganakiki kwa nkongu wa nalido ja mbiya yamaheli, na kumpaka mumagholu ghaka Yesu na kunhungula kwa majunju ghaki. Nyumba jokapi jakatweli unungilu wa mahuta ghanihagha.
Henu Yuda Isikalioti, jumu wa bhabhulwa komi na bhabheli, jonihoju nde joanaang'anambuka Yesu, akapwaghike,
“Bho, maghambu kiki manungilu ghanihagha ngacheghakahemaliwi kwa ipandi mia tatu yeilenganakiki kwa madini gha feza, na mbija yene kubhapekeha bhahocho?”

Yuda akapwaghiki bhenibhela, nga kwa ndandi ja kubhabhonela chiha bhahocho, nambu kwa ndandi akabhi mwihi. Maghambu jombi nde joakabhi abheka mfuku wa mbija, najombi akabhi ajibha yela yeyabhekakiki monihomu.
Nambu Yesu akapwaghike, “Ngamung'aha mabhu hoju! Mundekaje aghabhekaje kwa ndandi ja lichobha la kutaghakika kwangu.
Kwa ndandi bhahocho mbinabhu machobha ghokapi, nambu ngankubhi na nepani machobha ghokapi.”
Njama ja kunkoma Lazalo

Bhayahude bhamaheli bhakajowini kubha Yesu akabhi ku Besania. Henu, bhakahikiki konihoku nga kwa ndandi ja kumbona Yesu pela, nambu bhumbona kabheti na Lazalo, ambaju Yesu akamuhyohiki kuhuma kwa bhakuwa.
Nambu ihongozi bha bhapenganyambiku bhakatendiki njama ja kunkoma kabhete Lazalo,
maghambu kwa ndandi jaki Bhayahude bhamaheli bhakabhakaniki ihongozi bhabhu, na kunhobhale Yesu.
Yesu ajingi ku Yelusalemu kwa chiheku
Chilabhu jaki lipogha la bhandu bhabhakahikiki kwa ndandi ja Uwangalalu wa Pasaka, bhakajowini kubha Yesu abhi mwindela kuhika ku Yelusalemu.

Bhela bhakatoliki mambandi gha mikongu ja mitende, na kujenda kumpengana, na kujamalila bhakapwaghaje, “Chapanga apengalikaje! Apengalika jonihoju joahika kwa lihina laka Bambo! Apengalikaje Nkolongwa wa Izilaeli!”
Yesu akapatiki mwanaliponda jumu, na kukwela na kutama panani jaki, ngati moghalembakike mu Malembelu Mahuhu,

Bhabhulwa bhaka Yesu ngachebhakamanyi mambu ghanihagha hoti, nambu Yesu paakahyokike kuhuma kwa bhakuwa na paakalumbaliki, panihapa nde bhabhulwa bhaki bhakakombwiki kubha mambu ghanihagha ghakabhi ghalembakiki kwa ndandi jaki, na kubha bhakuntendi jombi.
Lipogha la bhandu bhala bhabhakabhi papamu na Yesu chikahi paandohika Lazalo kuhuma mulitengeli, na kumuhyoha kuhuma kwa bhakuwa, bhakabhalandi bhandu mambu ghala ghaghapitalile.
Kwa ndandi jeniheji lipogha la bhandu lakapiti kumpengana, maghambu bhakajowini kubha Yesu akahengiki ngangachu jeniheji.
Bhela Mafalisayo pabhakaghaweni ghanihagha bhakapwaghanile, “Mbona? Bho, ngatuwezi kutenda chokapi? Lingalyaje, bhandu bhokapi pundema bhunjengale jombi.”
Bhagiliki bhakumu bhapala kumbona Yesu
Kukabhi na Bhagiliki bhakumu pachilanda ja bhala bhabhahikiki ku Yelusalemu kujojabhela chikahi cha Uwangalalu wa Pasaka.
Bhanihabha bhakunjendi Filipo, mwenehi wa ku Betisaida ja inchi ja ku Galilaya, na kundobha, bhakapwaghaje, “Nkolongwa, tepani tupala kumbona Yesu.”
Filipo akapiti kumpwaghi Andulea, kabheti Andulea na Filipo bhakumpwaghi Yesu.
Yesu akabhayangike, “Lisaa la kulumbalika kwaka Mwana waka Mundu lihikike!
Numpwaghi chakaka, imbeju ya ingano nangakuhabhuka paluhombi na kuwa, ihighalila ngati imbeju kanjika jaki. Nambu ngati anaihawiki pahi na kuwa, jibheleka imbeju yamaheli.
Mundu jokapi joaghapala matamu ghaki anaaghahobhihaje, na mundu jokapi joaghahobheha matamu ghaki mu ndema ghoni anaaghakengalyaje hata womi wa mileli.
Mundu jokapi joapala kundumakila, impalika anyengalyaje, na nepani pamili, panihapa nde na mtumika wangu payibyaje. Kabheti mundu jokapi joandumakila nepani, Atati wangu anaampekya utopelu.
Yesu alongela panani ja kupotela kwaki
“Sajenu roho jangu jing'ahika, bho, henu mbwagha kike? ‘Atati, ungengalyaje mu chikahi chenu!’ Nambu nde kwa ndandi ja ghanihagha nakahikiki nahuli naghapetilaje mang'ahiku gha chikahi chenu.
Atati ulilumbalyaje lihina laku!” Panihapa sauti kuhuma kunani kumahunde jakapwaghike, “Nililumbalile, na ananililumbalya kabhete.”

Lipogha la bhandu bhabhakabhi pandu pala bhakajowini sauti jela, na bhakumu bhabhu bhakapwaghike, “Jeniheji nde sauti ja kulundamila kwa chitobhi.” Nambu bhangi bhakapwaghiki, “Mtumika wa kunani kwaka Chapanga atehi kulongela naku!”
Nambu Yesu akabhayangiki, “Sauti jeniheji ngachejabhili kwa ndandi jangu nepani, nambu kwa ndandi jinu mwehapa.
Sajenu nde chikahi cha kutemuliwa kwa ndema ghoni, henu Shetani, nkolongwa wa ndema ghoni anaalekalikaje kunja.
Nambu nepani panikwehakikaje kunani kuhuma pundema, ananabhahutaje bhandu bhokapi bhahikaje kwangu.”
Yesu akapwaghiki ghanihagha akalangiya kubha anapotilaje kwa ntundu bhole.

Bhela lipogha la bhandu lela lakalapwili njobhela lakapwaghaje, “Tujowini mu Shelia jitu kubha Kristo anatama mileli. Bho, uweza bholi henu kupwagha kubha impalika Mwana waka Mundu kujinuliwa kunani? Bho, henu Mwana waka Mundu nde nane?”
Yesu akapwaghike, “Unang'anu wakona ubhi na mwehapa kwa chikahi kichokope. Njendaje koni mbili na unang'anu, nahuli lwihi ngalwampata, maghambu joajenda mulwihi ngacheamanya koajenda.

Bhela kwa ndandi mbili na unang'anu, muuhobhalyaje unang'anu hoghu, nahuli mpata kubha mabhana bha unang'anu.” Bhandu ngachebhabhi na uhobhalelu Paakajomwi kulonge ghanihagha, Yesu akabhokike, na kulihiya nahuli ngabhumbona.
Nambu Yesu papamu na kutenda ngangachu hayeyi yokapi palongi jabhu, bhombi ngachebhunhobhalile.
Nahuli ghapata kupitalila malobhi ghaakapwaghiki mlota Isaya,

content.text: “Bambo, bho, nde nane joakauhobhalile ubholu wito?
Na bho, nde nane joayekuliwi makili ghaka Bambo?”

content: Ndemana bhombi ngachebhahobhalile, kwa ndandi Isaya akapwaghiki kabhete,
Mlota Isaya akapwaghiki malobhi ghanihagha kwa ndandi akauweni ulumbalilu waka Yesu, na akapwaghiki malobhi ghaki.

Hata bhela, bhamaheli pachilanda ja ihongozi bha Bhayahude bhakunhobhali Yesu. Nambu kwa ndandi ja Mafalisayo, ngachebhakapwaghiki palanga, kwa kujoghopa kubhatopola mu nyumba ya kuhimangani Bhayahude.
Kwa ndandi bhombi bhakapaliki ulumbalilu wa bhandu kuliku ulumbalilu waka Chapanga.
Malobhi ghaka Yesu anaghatemula bhandu
Yesu akajamalila kwa sauti ngolongwa, akapwaghaje, “Mundu joanhobhalela nepani, ngacheanhobhale nepani pela, nambu bhelabhela anhobhalela jola joandumike.
Na jola joaningali nepani andingali jola joandumike.
Nepani nhikiki nahuli mya unang'anu wa pundema, nahuli kila mundu joanhobhale nepani ngayitama mulwihi.
Na ngati mundu anaaghajowini malobhi ghangu, nambu ngacheaghakamula, nepani ngachenuntemula. Maghambu ngachenhikiki kuutemula ndema, nambu kuukengalela ndema.
Mundu joangana nepani, jwangakughahobhalela malobhi ghangu, abhi na wa kuntemula. Lilobhi heli lenilipwaghiki nde lelantemulaje mu lichobha la kujomukela.
Maghambu nepani ngachenapwaghiki kwa ndandi ja lujiniku lwangu, nambu Atati joandumiki, nde joanaghalakili cha kupwagha na ntundu monipwaghilaje.
Nanatu manyi kubha amuli yaki ileta womi wa mileli. Bhela nepani nongela malobhi ghala pela ghaanaghalakili Atati.”
